title: Get a licence for a temporary sign or trade display on a road or council property
what: Get the council's licence before placing a temporary sign or trade display on council property or a road, beyond the two small advertising signs and other signs the local law allows without one.

laws.title: Shire of Victoria Plains Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2018

sources.title: Shire of Victoria Plains Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2018
sources.quote: A person shall not on local government property or in a thoroughfare, without a licence—
